required_scope: Preserve original ordered final results/cancel events, immediate public controls, dynamic bounded requests, shared budget, no free samples, original-ticket recovery, and colluding-recipient joint observation.

normal_simulator_inputs.public: public capacity/catalog/route/work configuration, registered requests, control plan, network-fault plan and previously observed authorized results
normal_simulator_inputs.private_oracle: at most two action-bound full mechanism results; sampled once at each abstract L1
normal_simulator_inputs.excluded: raw slots, raw counts, partial kernel state, readiness flags, data-dependent failure selectors

round_order: record public arrivals and adaptive request selected only after prior received output
apply public controls and acknowledge application
answer polls from published journal only
advance one fixed public work quantum unless publicly paused
publish completed jobs in admission order with conceptual atomic WITHHELD or L3 admission
attempt original outbox at eligible route in global order; expired attempts use result-free terminal control
advance ordered application-final prefix through ACCEPTED/CLOSED/WITHHELD
observed_events: all routes SEND and RECEIVE including full approved result values

response_contract.SUBMIT: RECORDED with public job sequence, or public authorization/budget denial; no private-data existence test
response_contract.POLL: RECORDED plus prior public outcome or UNPUBLISHED; never READY/PENDING/STARTED/percent complete/partial vector
response_contract.CONTROL: CONTROL_RECORDED acknowledges application only; not proof of no prior/future authorized effect; no return of private completion state
response_contract.WITHHELD: only from public cancellation/revocation or registration policy; consumes original dummy work and enters ordered final stream
response_contract.ADMITTED: original immutable action/route/expiry and one outbox; not proof of receipt
response_contract.RETRY: original approved output and first acceptance fact; no new randomness, no expiry extension
response_contract.EXPIRED: result-free terminal reconciliation; receiver lock chooses existing ACCEPTED or CLOSED barrier
response_contract.PERMANENT_LOSS: remain ACTIVE; never infer CLOSED or refund from no reply

ordering.required_global: Later admitted output waits for earlier final acknowledgement; canonical application-final stream also orders WITHHELD behind unresolved earlier deliveries.
ordering.availability_cost: Slow or permanently unavailable prior recipient blocks later final events. Already-admitted later tickets may expire while queued; no automatic renewal or refund.
ordering.controls: Continue to be handled at public rounds; do not wait for batch completion or delivery ACK.
ordering.comparison_only: per_route profile is deliberately weaker; its successful privacy checks do NOT satisfy original global-order requirement and do not authorize replacing that requirement.
ordering.network_visibility: Raw transport observation is included separately even when canonical application events are buffered; application ordering cannot erase observed arrivals.

assumptions: Fixed contribution contract and approved full count/histogram kernels
Each conditional chosen mechanism has fixed cost (ln2, 2^(-(K+1))) and independent randomness
At most two mechanism draws, shared budget and no resampling on retry
Every non-oracle transition uses public state and already approved/received values only
Fault/control policy is public or depends only on allowed transcript, never unobserved raw data
Crypto/storage/runtime implementation must be shown to refine this simulator; not established here
conditional_argument.induction: Given public state and action-bound oracle transcript, the next request, control, scheduler choice, journal transition, retry/terminal packet and application event are reproducible without raw database access. This is structural by construction for the simulator, not a theorem about existing deployed code.
conditional_argument.composition: Two fixed-cost conditional mechanisms yield (2 ln2, 2^-K) by basic adaptive approximate-DP composition; remaining trace is postprocessing if the simulator premise holds.
conditional_argument.K1: Exact finite check uses epsilon multiplier 4 and delta bound 1/2.
conditional_argument.K40: Conditional target (2 ln2, 2^-40), before epsilon rounding to 1.4; no end-to-end production claim.
conditional_argument.infinite_traces: Only bounded prefixes checked. Permanent packet loss retained as ACTIVE; arbitrary-adversary/infinite-trace proof and liveness require separate work.

implementation_refinement_gates.requirement: Authenticated immutable public request/control journal with logical ordering and exact retry identity
implementation_refinement_gates.current: PublicGatewayLedger and loopback TLS service bind signed request to enrolled actor/domain/certificate, journal exact original response and execute effect atomically; five public methods and real lost-response retry verified.

implementation_refinement_gates.requirement: Atomically decide public WITHHELD or L3/outbox for each scheduled slot, preserving admission sequence
implementation_refinement_gates.current: AtomicPublicationSender couples scheduled eligibility, WITHHELD or guarded L3/outbox and public decision in one witnessed tick transaction; prototype/atomic_publication_contract.json. Full external gateway proof remains separate.

implementation_refinement_gates.requirement: Gate transmission by domain-wide final frontier across routes and ordered pre-L3 WITHHELD records
implementation_refinement_gates.current: OrderedPublicationSender gates result/first terminal preparation by domain-wide final prefix and atomically advances signed first-outcome/WITHHELD final records. Dual-recipient authenticated loopback, concurrency and local process cuts verified; external final feed/gateway remains open.

implementation_refinement_gates.requirement: Map every external error, poll, timeout, restore and health response into permitted view
implementation_refinement_gates.current: Pure public input validation, explicit public policy error inventory and strict server/client response vocabulary now implemented. 32 equal-approved-output runtime traces match across 96 directed neighbor comparisons; real TLS negative controls distinguish private failure or generic-policy alias. Unknown failures/health/overload and complete simulator mapping remain open.

implementation_refinement_gates.requirement: Recover public cursor/journal/frontiers and original samples without publishing stale state
implementation_refinement_gates.current: Public requests, response bytes, control links, pause state, publication decisions and final events are witnessed and checked before exact recovery. Stateless page cursors replay their original signed response; old replica is fenced after restored replica advances.

implementation_refinement_gates.current: Only loopback protocol execution and finite logical models; physical timing/packet length excluded
